caption: The drawing features a single large creature depicted in a circular frame. The creature has the body and head of a horse, but it possesses additional features including a large, bat-like wing on its back and a long, curled tail that ends in a fin-like or leafy structure. Its forelegs are raised, and its head is turned slightly forward with an open mouth and pronounced nostrils. The entire composition is rendered in shades of black and gray, creating a monochromatic effect against a light beige or off-white background. The creature is centered within the thick, dark circle, with its limbs and tail conforming to the curvature. In the lower right below the circle, the name "ROSE CAMPBELL CERNE" is written in small capital letters.
